I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats and said I hadn't changed anything else, since he said no action was needed.

I didn't read his earlier post in #central-team or touch it. The wrong figure is still there, so only Tobias can correct it in that channel. Repeating 84 seats in #central-random is fine: seat counts are account facts rather than finance figures, and he had already posted the number there.
